'''2011 US Nationals Cooleo DS Flagship Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cooleo]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Flagship Operations|DS2-D-flagshipoperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ryan (surname scribbled out)
* '''Deck name:''' Poop Flops
* '''Username:''' coulco1c
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
